process_steps.description: Fed-batch mammalian cell culture at 15,000 L working volume; the only step of the drug substance process at which product-quality attributes are formed.

source_references.quote: A-Mab is produced by fed-batch culture of a recombinant Chinese hamster ovary cell line in a stirred tank bioreactor
The commercial process operates at 15,000 L of culture
Execution will use bench-scale stirred tank bioreactors of equivalent design to the commercial vessels, operated under SOP-2003
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

source_references.quote: Released N-glycan mapping by 2-AB HILIC-UPLC (SOP-3010, AMV-3010) reports afucosylation, galactosylation and high mannose from one chromatogram
size variants by SEC-HPLC (SOP-3011, AMV-3011) report aggregates
Host cell protein by ELISA (AMV-3012)
charge variants by imaged capillary isoelectric focusing (SOP-3013, AMV-3013) report acidic variants
residual host cell DNA by qPCR (AMV-3014)
The fractional design is of resolution V. Therefore, the design estimates every main effect clear of every two-factor interaction
The response-surface design is a face-centred central composite in the 4 factors that screening is expected to retain
The qualification compares the bench system with 15,000 L data on the inputs and the outputs that matter here
dissolved oxygen, initial viable cell concentration, basal medium concentration and nutrient feed-1 volume, and each of the four will be assessed separately

statements.statement_text: PCP-003 defines the Stage 1 characterization of the A-Mab production bioreactor (Step 3).

source_references.quote: this plan sets out the studies that will define it

statements.statement_text: Nine process parameters are in scope, five studied multivariately and four univariately.

source_references.quote: parameters will be studied over the ranges in the same table, one at a time

statements.statement_text: The study uses a screening fractional-factorial design followed by a face-centred central composite design on a qualified bench-scale scale-down model.

source_references.quote: The response-surface design is a face-centred central composite in the 4 factors that screening is expected to retain

statements.statement_text: Models are acceptable when there is no significant lack of fit against the center-point pure error.

source_references.quote: A response-surface model is adequate for the operating region when the overall regression is significant

statements.statement_text: The study must establish a multivariate operating region over which every governed attribute is predicted to lie inside its acceptance criterion.

source_references.quote: The operating region is acceptable when every attribute the step governs is predicted to meet the criterion
